Evidence of stated policy intent rather than executed budget outcome. Austerity platform was later partially implemented but modified under fiscal pressure.","source_limitations":["Campaign pledge, not yet executed budget. Actual 2019-2024 fiscal execution showed deviations including some debt issuance and cost overruns on flagship projects.","Not a neutral assessment; sourced from sympathetic biographical coverage.","Covers policy intent through July 2018 but not the execution record."],"question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3"],"verification_status":"pending","verification_notes":[],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0002","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"AMLO's platform pledged a gradual minimum wage increase to 171 pesos by end of sexenio (2024) and elderly pensions of 1,500 pesos monthly, representing a redistribution commitment toward lower-income groups.","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"favorable","actor":"Andrés Manuel López Obrador","action":"pledged minimum wage and pension increases","mechanism":"legislated wage floors and social transfers","outcome":"Planned income support increases for workers and elderly poor","dates":["March 2018 campaign pledge","2024 end of sexenio target"],"quantities":["171 pesos (minimum wage target by 2024)","1,500 pesos monthly (elderly pension)"],"excerpt":"Habría un aumento gradual del salario mínimo, hasta los 171 pesos al final del sexenio, y lo mismo para las pensiones de adultos mayores, que cobrarían mensualidades de 1.500 pesos","locator":"extracted HTML block 62","attribution":"Book-length biography of López Obrador (CIDOB profile series); coverage through August 2018","period_fit":"Campaign period. Pledge represents intended policy rather than enacted outcome at time of passage.","source_limitations":["Campaign pledge not yet implemented. Actual minimum wage outcomes by 2023-2024 significantly exceeded 171 pesos (reached ~500 pesos daily in 2024), making the original target obsolete. La reforma energética de Peña Nieto sería sometida a una revisión a fondo, anulando y revirtiendo cuanto fuera necesario","locator":"extracted HTML block 62","attribution":"Book-length biography of López Obrador (CIDOB profile series); coverage through August 2018","period_fit":"Campaign period intent. Actual energy policy after 2018 reversed many 2013-2014 reforms, consolidated state oil company control, and import reduction was not achieved.","source_limitations":["Campaign pledge. Actual 2018-2024 energy policy showed contradictory outcomes: some refinery rehabilitation occurred but overall import dependence increased, not decreased, due to declining domestic production.","Not a neutral policy assessment."],"question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.10"],"verification_status":"pending","verification_notes":[],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0004","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"AMLO's platform adopted orthodox free-market macroeconomic principles (stable budgets, free trade, peso float, Bank of Mexico autonomy) alongside rejection of 'neoliberalism,' privatization, and 'foreignization' of strategic sectors—indicating internal tension between credible fiscal rules and strategic sector intervention.","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"mixed","actor":"Andrés Manuel López Obrador","action":"adopted orthodox macroeconomic framework while rejecting neoliberal policy direction","mechanism":"market orthodoxy commitments alongside strategic sector protections","outcome":"Platform presented as pragmatic social-democratic fusion with contradictory elements","dates":["March 2018 campaign platform"],"quantities":[],"excerpt":"asumía los principios ortodoxos del libre mercado, el libre comercio, la estabilidad macroeconómica, la disciplina presupuestaria, la flotación del peso y la autonomía del Banco de México, pero conjugadas, eso sí, con el rechazo al \"neoliberalismo\", las \"tendencias privatizadoras\" y la \"extranjerización\" de sectores estratégicos","locator":"extracted HTML block 63","attribution":"Book-length biography of López Obrador (CIDOB profile series); coverage through August 2018","period_fit":"Campaign period (2018). Platform-level description of economic ideology and stated direction rather than executed policy or budget outcome.","source_limitations":["Platform description, not executed policy. The tension between stated orthodox commitments and protectionist instincts was partially reflected in actual 2018-2024 policy—some orthodox elements maintained (central bank autonomy, peso float) while others were violated (selective industrial policy, energy sector reversals).","Biographical source rather than independent economic analysis."],"question_ids":["5B.1","5B.3","5B.4","5B.10"],"verification_status":"pending","verification_notes":[],"premium_verification_required":false},{"draft_id":"D0005","source_id":"BOOK-013","claim":"AMLO pledged to eradicate political corruption 'giving example' from the presidency, stating corruption is 'not a cultural phenomenon but the result of a decaying regime,' and committed to punishingcorruption regardless of position ('including compañeros, officials, friends, and family').","claim_type":"source_assertion","polarity":"favorable","actor":"Andrés Manuel López Obrador","action":"pledged zero-corruption rule with personal accountability","mechanism":"institutional example from presidency; threat of punishment for all","outcome":"Planned elimination of corruption and impunity","dates":["July 1, 2018 electoral victory speech","August 8, 2018 TEPJF validation"],"quantities":[],"excerpt":"\"Bajo ninguna circunstancia, el próximo presidente permitirá la corrupción ni la impunidad.
